sentences: When visitors walk into the round main hall of the Central Library in Los Angeles, many of them stop and look up at a huge open book.
It is the world's largest **pop-up** book, and when it is open, it **measures** thirty-one feet by twenty feet and **weighs** more than eighteen hundred pounds.
The book was **designed** by a local artist, Daniel González, who worked with a paper engineer, and it was made to **celebrate** the library's one hundredth birthday.
The finished book was too large for the library's doors, so it was built in smaller **sections** and put together inside the hall.
en.answer: 방문객들이 로스앤젤레스 중앙도서관의 둥근 중앙 홀에 들어서면, 많은 사람이 멈춰 서서 커다랗게 펼쳐진 책을 올려다본다.
